entities.summary: Henadzi Yurievich Aliashchuk also written as Gennady Oleshchuk is a former weightlifter from Belarus, who competed in the men's featherweight class weight at the 2000 Summer Olympics and won a bronze medal. He was born in Babruysk. He set the world record for the men's 62 kg category in 2001, lifting 181 kg.
